test_run_repository_put_get: test RunRepository put and get methods to store and retrieve run records from the SQLite-backed database
test_run_repository_update_status: test RunRepository update_status method to change a run status to running or error with optional error message
test_run_repository_list_by_thread: test RunRepository list_by_thread method to query runs filtered by thread id with optional user and limit
test_run_repository_update_completion: test RunRepository update_run_completion method to record token counts llm calls and messages for a finished run
test_run_repository_delete: test RunRepository delete method to remove a run record and verify nonexistent deletes are safe noops
